{{CharInfobox| color={{normal color}} | corecolor={{normal color light}} | bordercolor={{normal color dark}} | name=Lisa | jname=リン | tmname=Rin | slogan=no | image=Lisa.png | caption=Lisa | gender=Female | hometown=Unknown | region=[[Johto]] | relatives=Unknown| trainer=yes | trainerclass=[[Pokémon Trainer]] | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=M03 | epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei | enva=[[Lisa Ortiz]]| java=Ai Katō| }} '''Lisa''' (Japanese: '''リン''' ''Rin'') is a supporting character who appeared in ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who challenged {{Ash}} to a [[Full Battle]]. ==History== While {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were traveling, they encountered Lisa, who challenged Ash to a [[Full Battle]]. Ultimately, Lisa's {{p|Girafarig}} and {{p|Butterfree}} defeated [[Ash's Chikorita]] and {{AP|Bulbasaur}}; his {{AP|Totodile}}, {{AP|Noctowl}}, and {{AP|Cyndaquil}} defeated her {{p|Granbull}}, {{p|Aipom}}, and {{p|Mankey}}, respectively; and [[Ash's Pikachu]] and her {{p|Quagsire}} came to a draw, thus giving Ash the win. Afterwards, she and her Pokémon had lunch with the group. Upon learning the group was looking for a [[Pokémon Center]], Lisa escorted them to the nearby [[Greenfield]]. However, upon arriving, they realized the area had been turned into a crystal wasteland that was still spreading. {{an|Professor Oak}} and {{Delia|Ash's mother}} soon arrived to investigate the phenomenon, including the disappearance of their mutual friend [[Spencer Hale]]. Following Delia's kidnapping by an {{OBP|Entei|M03}}, Ash and his friends went against Oak's orders and rushed to the epicenter of the event, the Hale mansion. In support of Ash, Lisa gave Ash her [[Pokégear]] to coordinate the rescue mission and then remained at the Pokémon Center with Oak and [[Schuyler]]. After the crisis was resolved, Lisa waved goodbye to the group and left to continue her journey. ==Character== Lisa is amiable, easygoing, and enjoys a challenge. She also looks out for her friends, like when she gave Ash her [[Pokégear]] to avoid having him rush into things without any help. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Lisa's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisa |pkmn=Aipom |type1=Normal |img=Lisa Aipom.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |vajp=Etsuko Kozakura |vaen=Etsuko Kozakura |desc={{p|Aipom}} is Lisa's primary Pokémon and is often seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside of its Ball]]. It volunteered to go third in Lisa's battle with Ash. It proved to be extremely agile and graceful, using its tail as both a trapeze and a weapon in battle. However, this agility proved no match for [[Ash's Noctowl]], who attacked it relentlessly and knocked it out with {{m|Tackle}}. None of Aipom's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisa |pkmn=Granbull |type1=Normal |img=Lisa Granbull.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc={{p|Granbull}} was Lisa's first choice of Pokémon to battle Ash. Its size made it too slow to catch the agile {{AP|Totodile}}, who knocked it out with a single {{m|Water Gun}}. Granbull's only known move is {{m|Bite}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisa |pkmn=Girafarig |type1=Normal |type2=Psychic |img=Lisa Girafarig.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc={{p|Girafarig}} was sent out to battle {{AP|Chikorita}}, and proved to be a powerful battler, coming very close to hitting Chikorita on its first attack. It was tripped over by {{m|Vine Whip}}, but managed to dodge the {{m|Razor Leaf}} and struck Chikorita with a Psybeam, dazing her and knocking her out of the match. Girafarig's known moves are {{m|Stomp}} and {{m|Psybeam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisa |pkmn=Butterfree |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Lisa Butterfree.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc={{p|Butterfree}} was Lisa's fourth choice of Pokémon to battle Ash, fighting his {{AP|Bulbasaur}}. It deflected Bulbasaur's {{m|Vine Whip}} easily, and then dazed it with Sleep Powder, before finishing it off with a gust of wind. Butterfree's known moves are {{m|Safeguard}}, {{m|Sleep Powder}}, and {{m|Whirlwind}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisa |pkmn=Mankey |type1=Fighting |img=Lisa Mankey.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc={{p|Mankey}} was sent out to fight [[Ash's Cyndaquil]]. It was quick and agile, but only managed to land one blow on Cyndaquil before it was blasted by {{m|Flamethrower}} and defeated. None of Mankey's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisa |pkmn=Quagsire |type1=Water |type2=Ground |img=Lisa Quagsire.png |epnum=M03 |epname=Spell of the Unown: Entei |desc={{p|Quagsire}} was Lisa's final Pokémon. Unlike the rest of her team, it was slow and worked defensively rather than offensively. It completely shook off {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{t|Electric}} attacks, and met his physical ones with blows of its own. It blew Pikachu away with Water Gun, but when Pikachu used the swing set momentum to propel himself into a falling headbutt, both Pokémon were knocked out, resulting in a draw and giving Ash three wins to Lisa's two.
